utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon. If you’re heading over, I’d go soon before the best stuff gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is it really picking up that well? I might head over soon, then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it really is—there’s a nice little crowd over there now. If you go soon, you’ll probably catch the good stuff before it gets boxed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik. I might miss a few updates, but I’ll try to keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Noah — I’ll keep repeating the details around the block so nobody misses it. If you hear anything, just pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I bring my stuff over?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime after 4 works — I’ll be around then, and we can sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll swing by after 4 with my stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I could use screws, duct tape, and a couple sturdy extension cords if you can spare them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring those by—I’ve got some screws and duct tape, and I’ll check for extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the repair drive work around school pickup if we keep it early. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Morning would be best for me — maybe around 8:30? That should still leave plenty of time before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 works for me. I’ll plan around that and head over after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, Oren. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, first we should sort the list of broken things and who can handle each one. Then I’ll ask around for tools and set a time to start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. Let’s make the list first, then we can match people to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, the repair drive is coming up soon — want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — maybe save me a spot near the entrance if you can. I’m just trying to sort out when I can get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll save you a spot near the entrance. Just text me when you know your timing, and I’ll keep an eye out for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still getting the details second-hand. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's coming together nicely. I’m still finalizing a few details, but I can share the time and place if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—time and place would be great. I’m still a bit behind on the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before I jump in—what needs fixing, and when do you need it done?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re fixing up small household things like leaky faucets, loose handles, and broken shelves. If you can help, I’d love to have it done by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds doable—I’ll help with the faucets, handles, and shelves, and I’ll aim to have everything finished by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I can take on one simple task and join late if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. If you can grab the tools list, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a hammer and a screwdriver I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring them over anytime.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive location—where should I head?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Head to the community center on Maple, by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll head to the community center on Maple by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if we’re short on tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Rey—just let me know what you’re missing and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the pickup and drop-off details are clear first. What time are you thinking, and where should I bring everything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good question — can you confirm what time works best for you, and whether you want me to bring everything to your place or meet somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do early afternoon, and it’d be easiest if you brought everything to my place. Then I can help sort it out here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what do you want me to tell folks?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — please tell folks we’re gathering tools, spare parts, and volunteer hands for the repair drive this Saturday. If they can help, send them my way and I’ll coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll tell people we’re gathering tools, spare parts, and volunteer hands for Saturday, and send anyone who can help your way for coordination.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll probably join a little late, but I can help once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what’s still needed when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—folks are already pitching in with tools and time. If you want, I can keep an ear out for when they set the next workday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Tess—thank you. Please let me know as soon as they pick the next workday, and I’ll try to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll let you know the moment I hear the next workday. I’ll keep it in mind with the school schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Bo—thank you. I’ll send you the list of urgent repairs and the time window so you can pick what fits best.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—send it over when you can, and I’ll grab one that fits my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly small stuff: loose cabinet hinges, squeaky doors, and a couple leaky faucets. If you can take any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the squeaky doors and one leaky faucet. Tell me where to start, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive invites now—want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd appreciate that. If you hear anything else about it, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, thank you. Just let me know the place and time, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll note the place and time as soon as I have them, and I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive start yet, or are we still gathering donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check whether it’s started or if we’re still collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — just let me know which it is when you check.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the repair drive going? I just ran a few errands, so I can swing by if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’m just getting things sorted, so if you could swing by and give me a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I can swing by in a bit and help sort things out.
